product.summary: Illustrative closed fragrance-bottle subject; replace this description only after inspecting the actual supplied product image.
product.state: Assumed closed, upright and assembled; must be confirmed from the real attachment.
user_supplied: Illustrative request for a low-key fragrance hero photograph; not an observed real SKU.
unknown: Actual silhouette, proportions, cap, glass color and finish
identity_lock: Preserve the actual inspected silhouette, proportions, closure, materials, color, label and component count; this template does not establish those facts.

references.use: Product identity and evidenced front viewpoint only. This is a non-executable placeholder, not an attached image.

shot.purpose: One low-key brand photograph, not a redesigned package or a finished ad.
required_visible: Entire closed bottle, cap and front label, subject to source inspection
required_printing: Existing front-label printing, if confirmed in the actual inspected source

look.notes: Retained shadow detail and tactile stone; no recoloring of the real SKU.

camera.angle: Same front-facing viewpoint if confirmed by the actual image; do not invent a different face.
camera.framing: Portrait 2:3, whole bottle visible and centered, with all required components inside the crop.
camera.focus: Label, cap and outline legible; distant background softer.

lighting.key: Broad oblique key from upper left.
lighting.fill_and_separation: Controlled label fill, restrained edge highlight and material-appropriate reflections.
lighting.shadows: Soft contact shadow on the stone, consistent with the key; no unexplained second hard shadow.

must_include: Actual inspected product image as the first attachment before generation
Same visible product identity and evidenced state
must_avoid: Label redesign or transcription as new text

assumptions: Prompt-only illustration; no actual product image has been inspected.
Replace the example source, inspect it, resolve actual facts, and verify attachment transport before requesting generation.
Reference guidance is best effort, not a pixel-preservation guarantee.
